description: This PHP source file defines the RegistrationAPIClientService class responsible for interfacing with an external registration API using Guzzle HTTP client. It includes methods for creating the API client and publishing data via POST requests, with integrated logging and exception handling.

classes.name: RegistrationAPIClientService
classes.description: Service class for communicating with the registration API endpoint, providing data publishing capability and internal client management.

methods.name: getApiClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a singleton instance of the Guzzle HTTP Client configured with the registration URL.

methods.name: publishData
methods.description: Sends data to the registration API via POST request, handles response, and logs errors if exceptions occur.
